title_as_printed: Experimental and calculated water content for H2S liquid in equilibrium with a hydrate phase.

footnotes_as_printed.a: Stability during temperature measurements was calculated to be +-0.1K (well within the 95% confidence uncertainty of the PRT).
footnotes_as_printed.b: Expanded uncertainty for pressure measurements calculated to be +-0.001 MPa (95% confidence).
footnotes_as_printed.c: Uncertainty for water content measurements is 2% relative and reproducibility for triplicate measurements was within a standard deviation of 25 ppm
